description: Thirty real corpus UNVERIFIED/residual tags frozen at harvest so remesure does not walk a growing receipts tree. Generator and runner still execute live against these pinned claims.

tags.claim: google.antigravity.workflows is tagged verification=UNVERIFIED in command-center/wfa/WFA-0021-sweep-vendor-documentation.json with verification_kinds=['docs']. Quote: Once saved, Workflows can be invoked in Agent via a slash command with the format /workflow-name.

google.antigravity.rules is tagged verification=UNVERIFIED in command-center/wfa/WFA-0021-sweep-vendor-documentation.json with verification_kinds=['docs']. Quote: Rules are manually defined constraints for the Agent to follow, at both the local and global levels.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Run tools/plugin/longrun.py with windows=True under pwsh7.
tags.claim: scripts/longrun.ps1 was not executed under pwsh on this Linux worktree; it delegates to the same heartbeat.py as longrun.sh.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Re-run tools/council/stability.py against a live compiled CouncilSpec once IMP-0260/IMP-0329 and the 72-preset file are on disk.
tags.claim: Live vendor councils (IMP-0260 seed pinning, IMP-0329 calibration store, 12-COUNCIL-PROTOCOLS-AND-PRESETS.json 72 presets) were not executed. Rates are for the fixture pack in tools/council/fixtures/stability/presets.json.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Deliver TST-0326 walker and join this seed registry to the full collected set.
tags.claim: command-center/TEST-REGISTRY.json is scoped to the TST-0343 seed-sweep suite. Estate-wide discovery of every collectible test is TST-0326 and is not claimed here.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Wire MigrationLedger.begin_step into IMP-0047 apply.
tags.claim: IMP-0047 (versioned step framework) is not delivered on this worktree; the ledger seam is exercised by legacy_layout_steps stand-ins for the four historical layouts IMP-0048 will detect.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Owner answers Q9 in OWNER-DECISIONS.md.
tags.claim: Owner question Q9 is still OPEN. This unit adopts measurement-only ratings as its computational stance; it does not record an owner signature closing Q9.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: IMP-0077 signature verification and IMP-0094 decomposable quality score must make those measurements expensive to fake.
tags.claim: The formula trusts its input measurements. Fabricated conformance or stub signed releases can still yield HIGH.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: IMP-0083 / IMP-0008 delivery on this worktree.
tags.claim: IMP-0083 deterministic SAT resolver and IMP-0008 live `claude --version` negotiation are not re-implemented here; this unit is the compatibility filter the resolver calls, with fail-closed version parsing.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Re-run extract_all on IMP-0165's live imported candidates when that unit delivers.
tags.claim: IMP-0165 imported-candidate corpus is not on this worktree; extraction ran on a disclosed fixture set that includes the six spec-named expressions plus planted inexpressible rules.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: After IMP-0170 lands, hash the same fixtures with both fingerprinters and require equality on rename mutants and inequality on gate mutants.
tags.claim: IMP-0170's production fingerprint module is not on this worktree; IMP-0184 ships a local rename-invariant fingerprint used by union collapse. A later IMP-0170 delivery must be compared, not assumed equal.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Re-run registration through the IMP-0230 scaffold output when that unit is delivered.
tags.claim: IMP-0230 scaffold generator is not on this tree; this unit registers four complete blueprints against a local six-element contract rather than importing that generator.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Re-run registration once IMP-0230 lands.
tags.claim: Estate-wide registration against the IMP-0230 scaffold gate is not executed here because IMP-0230 is absent.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Place a module with run_council(spec) on one of delegate._RUNTIME_CANDIDATES and re-run probe1; runtime_present must become true and status DELEGATED.
tags.claim: Phase-7A / B07 council runtime is not importable on this worktree (delegate status HANDED-OFF-RUNTIME-ABSENT). The 9 entries still compile a CouncilSpec and name the handoff; they do not grow a local deliberation engine.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Re-run after IMP-0265 lands and pass registry seats through recruit().
tags.claim: IMP-0265 registry.py is a catalog dependency and is not imported. elastic.py accepts seat dicts with identity/expertise fields.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Seat a live recruit with a withheld consensus and score first-round correlation against the standing majority.
tags.claim: First-output independence on live LLM tokens is not measured. This unit's check is mechanical: context leak plus first-output echo against a fixture consensus string.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Add a paraphrase-identity arm: critic writes 'the author, Alice', and require a structured identity field still be absent while disclosing paraphrase as residual.
tags.claim: Isolation is a projection plus token redaction. A critic who paraphrases proposer identity without using the planted token would not be caught by the string census.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Add a labelled synonym slice and report the drop in recall.
tags.claim: Synonym-only answers with no shared content token and no typed cue can still be labelled EVASION (false negative).

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Label 60 recorded live-council position changes independently of this detector and recompute P/R.
tags.claim: Precision/recall is implementation-fidelity on a construction-intent corpus of 60, not a held-out human annotation of live council transcripts.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Add a position-extractor probe with planted paraphrase pairs and report disagreement with the label field.
tags.claim: Positions are discrete labels. Free-text NLI ('I now agree with the chair') is not extracted.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: When kernel.py exists, assert every participant turn event reaches detect() and that a topology cannot write a position change the detector never sees.
tags.claim: The detector is a pure function over traces. IMP-0264 kernel.py and IMP-0310 deadlock.py are not present on this Linux worktree; this unit does not claim event-loop wiring.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: After IMP-0264 kernel is on disk, replay 20 matched councils with shuffled order on a frozen prompt set.
tags.claim: First-speaker bias in a live multi-model council (human or LLM). This unit measures a deterministic anchoring plurality, not IMP-0264 kernel turns.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Diff strategy names against the specification schema enum when that file is present.
tags.claim: 11-COUNCIL-SPECIFICATION.md/.schema.json are not in this worktree; strategy names were taken from the catalog row.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Re-run support_check against argument_graph SUPPORTS edges once IMP-0313 lands; re-run split fan-in through nested.py once IMP-0288 lands.
tags.claim: Catalog dependencies IMP-0288 (nested subcouncil spawn) and IMP-0313 (argument graph) are not on disk. decompose.py is self-contained: support tracing is claim/content matching, not argument_graph.py edges, and split does not call nested.py.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Assign a reviewer who did not author decompose.py and starts from the probe fixtures.
tags.claim: Catalog reviewer_requirement names a human adversarial reviewer in a fresh context. G-1 uses named probe2 as the independent test-first control, not a second authoring agent.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Add a held-out prose-only packet set and measure independent-vs-coupled precision of the text splitter.
tags.claim: Free-text split without clause annotations is implemented (parse_text_clauses) but the 8 unit fixtures all supply typed clauses; unannotated prose compounds were not scored.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Owner-authorized run of decide() on a disposable clone of the live worktree, comparing git status before/after revert.
tags.claim: retain.py was not executed against the live repository tree; all tree-hash evidence is from isolated tempfile fixtures.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Deliver IMP-0372 and feed its measurement record into decide().
tags.claim: IMP-0372 (measure.py / measured noise band) is a dependency and is not delivered here. retain.py consumes a measurement record; it does not itself measure the noise band.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Deliver IMP-0420 / IMP-0421 and wire this scheduler in front of them.
tags.claim: IMP-0420 Claude adapter and IMP-0421 Codex adapter are not delivered on this worktree. This unit schedules a typed provider boundary, not live vendor CLIs.

tags.authored_settling_experiment: Deliver IMP-0445 and pass its predicate as headroom_ok.
tags.claim: IMP-0445 commit-charge headroom guard is not delivered; the scheduler exposes headroom_ok as an input gate.
